name: eCITE Internet
summary: Adelaide dialup/ADSL + hosting ISP (149 Hutt St; formerly BigBlue; ~2001-02); defunct (ECITE INTERNET PTY LTD, ACN 089 386 274).

events.details: Defunct. ISP access side was still sold in Aug 2006 (not 2004); hard end is the company's ABN cancellation 12 Jul 2010; webhosting continuation does not extend ISP death.

refs.label: still retailing ADSL Apr 2005 — contradicts c.2004
ADSL/ADSL2+ pages still served 21 Aug 2006 — last retail-access evidence (archive gap until 2014)
operator company deregistered; homepage blank by Jan 2014 and hosting-only 'eCITE Online' since (still live 2026 — non-ISP survival)
